en.headline: Police arrest 61-year-old man over suspected drugging of DJ Mao Hamasaki in Tsim Sha Tsui
en.dek: The local man was held in Central on Monday on suspicion of administering poison with intent to injure after the former Japanese actress collapsed at a Mody Road venue on 1 November.
body: Police arrested a 61-year-old local man in Central on Monday over the suspected drugging of former Japanese adult-film actress and disc jockey Mao Hamasaki in Tsim Sha Tsui.

The incident occurred in the early hours of 1 November. Hamasaki, 33, had finished a set at a Wan Chai bar and, with her 44-year-old manager, went to a venue on Mody Road. She reportedly drank whisky, and around 3.30am a stranger handed her a glass of orange juice. After drinking it she felt disoriented, went limp and suffered convulsions.

Her manager noticed white powdery residue in the glass, took her out and called police. She was taken to Queen Elizabeth Hospital and admitted to intensive care. Her manager said a urine sample tested positive for four drugs. Police classified the case as administering poison with intent to injure.
The arrested man is being detained for investigation.

zh.headline: 警方拘捕61歲男子 涉尖沙咀懷疑落藥前AV女優濱崎真緒
zh.dek: 本地男子周一在中環被捕，涉嫌意圖傷害而施用毒藥；事件於11月1日凌晨在麼地道場地發生。
body: 警方周一在中環拘捕一名61歲本地男子，涉及前日本成人電影演員兼DJ濱崎真緒在尖沙咀被懷疑落藥事件。
事件發生在11月1日凌晨。33歲的濱崎真緒在灣仔完成演出後，與 44歲經理人前往麼地道一間場地。據報她飲用威士忌，約凌晨3時30分有陌生人遞上橙汁。飲用後她感到迷失方向、全身無力並抽搐。
經理人發現杯底有白色粉末殘渣，帶她離開並報警。她被送往伊利沙伯醫院，入住深切治療部。經理人指尿液樣本對四種藥物呈陽性。警方將案件列為意圖傷害而施用毒藥。
被捕男子正被扣留調查。
